Undergraduate Students
We offer a bachelor's degree in civil engineering or environmental engineering. Both programs prepare students for careers in the built environment. While civil engineers deal with construction and infrastructure, environmental engineers focus on the systems for managing infrastructure.
Civil Engineering>>
Environmental Engineering>>
Undergraduate Transfer Students
You've laid the foundation for a successful future career in engineering. Now take it further. Rutgers School of Engineering accepts qualified transfer students from community colleges and other universities, both nationally and internationally.
Transfer Guidelines>>
Graduate Students
The Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering offers master's studies and doctoral degree programs with concentrations in focused research areas. All graduate students apply through Rutgers School of Graduate Studies.
